sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 48.1 "Ethernet introduction" in chapter 48 (Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2133.

The Ethernet peripheral enables to transmit and receive data over Ethernet in compliance
with the IEEE 802.3-2015 standard.
The peripheral is configurable to meet the needs of a large variety of consumer and
industrial applications.
